titles.title: There Is a Fountain (Full of Love)

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 c1 v3 v4 o1 o2

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Immanuel’s veins
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Lose all their guilty stains
Lose all their guilty stains
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in His day
And there may I, though vile as he
Wash all my sins away

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Wash all my sins away
Wash all my sins away
And there may I, though vile as he
Wash all my sins away

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Hallelujah
Fountain full of love for us
Poured out on us

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
E’er since by faith I saw that stream
Thy flowing wounds supply
Redeeming love has been my theme
And shall be till I die

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
And shall be till I die
And shall be till I die
Redeeming love has been my theme
And shall be till I die

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave
Then in a nobler, sweeter song
I’ll sing Thy power to save

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
I’ll sing Thy power to save
I’ll sing Thy power to save
Then in a nobler, sweeter song
I’ll sing Thy power to save

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
My sins are washed
Though they were scarlet
Now white as snow

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
Thank You for the wound in Your side
You made a way for me
You made a way for me

verse.name: v4c
verse.lines:
It is Thy power to save
It is Thy power to save
Then in a nobler, sweeter song
I’ll sing Thy power to save
